forma = {

    \time 12/8
    \key sib\major
    \tempo 2. = 67
    \once \override Score.RehearsalMark.extra-offset = #'(+2 . +1)
    \mark\markup\huge "Giga"
    \partial 8 s8
    s1.*14
    s2. s4. s4
    \bar":..:"\break
    s8
    s1.*19
    \bar":|."

}
